title: Test: verify error context preserved in router.rs after .ok()? removal
description: After router.rs .ok()? replacement (sibling bead), write or extend a test that triggers a parse failure path (e.g. malformed DAO bytes) and verifies the error variant is preserved (not just None). Use assert!(matches!(result, Err(DaoError::TooShort(_)))) or similar. Verify: cd rust && cargo test -p lichen-node -- routing
